integrity_statement: Proof gives an all-parameter combinatorial argument; finite computations are supplementary. Literature comparisons exclude previously published ambient homotopy and reversal-character claims. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only endpoint reversal of the full strong path matching complex is covered; sphere statements are up to homotopy, not PL homeomorphism to a standard sphere. No arbitrary subgroup, ordinary Morse complex, or equivariant splitting is classified. Unindexed equivalent literature is possible.
title: Reflection-fixed spheres in strong Morse complexes of paths
